items.title: Nickelodeon Commercial Breaks (April 1998)
items.description:
It's the mother load for 90's Nick fans, and probably my proudest eBay acquisition to date. Most of these ads come from episodes of Rugrats, but there's a Little Bear break somewhere in the middle and some commercials leading in to an episode of What Would You Do? at the very end.
